updates.summary: Ce qui a change Ajout de GitLab merge request URL prise en charge to the --worktree flag and the claude agents view (where MRs display as !N) Ajout de an opt-in forward_utilisateur_identity apps gateway parametre on Anthropic upstreams that sends the signed-in utilisateur's identity as headers, so a proxy behind the gateway can attribute spend per us
updates.summary_en:
What's changed

Added GitLab merge request URL support to the --worktree flag and the claude agents view (where MRs display as !N)
Added an opt-in forward_user_identity apps gateway setting on Anthropic upstreams that sends the signed-in user's identity as headers, so a proxy behind the gateway can attribute spend per us

updates.summary: Ce qui a change Subagent duplication is now on by par defaut: a subagent_taper: "dupliquer" subagent inherits the full conversation and prompt cache, and non-teammate agent spawns in interactive sessions now run in the arriere-plan by par defaut Taper @ in the prompt to mention another Claude session by nom; Claude then uses SendMessage to reach that
updates.summary_en:
What's changed

Subagent forking is now on by default: a subagent_type: "fork" subagent inherits the full conversation and prompt cache, and non-teammate agent spawns in interactive sessions now run in the background by default
Type @ in the prompt to mention another Claude session by name; Claude then uses SendMessage to reach that
